company.history: Based in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu, India, JSMW – Jose Sirumalai Wild Honey brings natural wild honey harvested around the Sirumalai hills directly to households across India and international destinations. Official founding dates and company milestones can be added by the administrator.
company.brandStory: Our brand narrative focuses on transparent, minimally handled wild honey from Dindigul, preserving the natural colour, viscosity, and seasonal floral character of each harvest. Administrators can update this story anytime from the dashboard.
company.sourcingInfo: Honey is sourced from traditional forest and hill-margin foraging zones in and around Sirumalai, Dindigul district, Tamil Nadu, with seasonal floral variation reflected in every batch.
company.mission: To offer genuine, minimally processed natural wild honey from Dindigul with honest product documentation, transparent sourcing, and reliable domestic and international fulfilment.
company.vision: To represent Sirumalai wild honey from Tamil Nadu on the international stage through integrity, traceability, and unhurried artisanal care.
values: Honest Provenance from Dindigul, Tamil Nadu
